summary: The candidate fixes the independently reported standard action-response envelope loss and preserves candidate fields in JSON and NumPy/msgpack-oriented modes. Its focused tests pass and its mean reducer matches an independent MI350X reference. It is still a partial original-issue implementation: a candidate_trajectory request sent to a non-opt-in ActionSamplingParams model is silently ignored and executes with num_outputs_per_prompt=1 instead of being rejected, contrary to the requested capability-validation contract.

tests.what_was_measured: At the recorded base commit, an internal output containing candidate_group and candidates produced a standard response with neither field.
Candidate regression/unit coverage: 157 passed, 43 subtests passed.

tests.command: PYTHONPATH=/job/repo/python /tmp/amdpilot-repo-j-16ffd0038b1f/venv/bin/python - <<'PY' # independent action transport, reducer, seed, and non-opt-in capability checks
tests.what_was_measured: Standard JSON retains candidate fields and converts arrays to lists; preserve_numpy retains ndarrays; mean and seed-order references pass; Pi05/non-opt-in candidate_trajectory is silently ignored with one output.
On AMD Instinct MI350X, a 3-candidate float32 mean matched a float64-sum/divide independent reference after conversion, max absolute error 0.0.

gpu_execution.evidence: One assigned AMD Instinct MI350X was used for the reducer numerical reference only. No Cosmos3 weights were available, so this does not validate model execution or semantic action quality.

native_rebuild_evidence: The candidate changes only Python and report files; repository-environment.json declares native=null and no C/C++/CUDA/HIP source changed, so no native rebuild was applicable.
remaining_counterexamples: For an ActionSamplingParams model without a declared candidate capability (reproduced with Pi05SamplingParams), parameters.candidate_trajectory={count:2,reducer:mean} is silently omitted and num_outputs_per_prompt remains 1. The original contract requires non-opt-in pipelines to reject the field rather than treating or ignoring it as an ordinary request.
remaining_limitations: Cosmos3 model weights were unavailable; no model-backed HTTP serving, denoising, action denormalization, semantic accuracy, or end-to-end batched-versus-sequential parity was run.
CFG serial/parallel membership, TP/SP reconstruction-before-reduction, unrelated-request dynamic co-batching, cancellation and one-candidate failure semantics remain unverified.
Candidate observability metrics requested by the issue (candidate count, physical forwards, fallback reason, reducer time, action-only branch time) are not implemented by this candidate.

The requested N={1,2,4,8,10} latency, memory, forward-count, conditioning-time, reducer-time, parity, quality, and multi-topology benchmarks were not supplied or independently runnable without the model.
The tiny Llama transport fixture is not a Cosmos3 action architecture and cannot qualify these missing model-specific paths, so it was not used as substitute evidence.
